tests.name: hasProtocol should return true for "https://example.com" with opts undefined
hasProtocol should return false for "//example.com" with opts undefined
hasProtocol should return true for "//example.com" with opts {"acceptRelative":true}
hasProtocol should return true for "//example.com" with opts true
hasProtocol should return true for "ftp://example.com" with opts undefined
hasProtocol should return true for "data:text/plain" with opts undefined
hasProtocol should return false for "data:text/plain" with opts {"strict":true}
hasProtocol should return true for "http://" with opts undefined
hasProtocol should return false for "/foo/bar" with opts undefined
hasTrailingSlash should return true for "/foo/" (respectQueryAndFragment: false)
hasTrailingSlash should return false for "/foo" (respectQueryAndFragment: false)
hasTrailingSlash should return false for "/foo?query=true" (respectQueryAndFragment: true)
hasTrailingSlash should return true for "/foo/?query=true" (respectQueryAndFragment: true)
hasTrailingSlash should return false for "" (respectQueryAndFragment: false)
withQuery should add or replace the query section of the URL
filterQuery should filter the query section using predicate
getQuery should parse and decode the query object of an input URL
isEmptyURL & isNonEmptyURL isEmptyURL should correctly identify empty or '/' URLs
isEmptyURL & isNonEmptyURL isNonEmptyURL should correctly identify non-empty, non-'/' URLs
joinRelativeURL should join relative URL to "/b/c"
joinRelativeURL should join relative URL to "a/b/c"
joinRelativeURL should join relative URL to "/"
withHttp, withHttps, withoutProtocol, withProtocol withHttp should set protocol to http://
withHttp, withHttps, withoutProtocol, withProtocol withHttps should set protocol to https://
withHttp, withHttps, withoutProtocol, withProtocol withoutProtocol should remove protocol
withHttp, withHttps, withoutProtocol, withProtocol withProtocol should add or replace protocol
normalizeURL should normalize the input URL
resolveURL should resolve multiple URL segments
resolveURL should throw TypeError when base is not a string
resolveURL should return base when filteredInputs is empty
isSamePath should return true for isSamePath("/foo", "/foo/")
isSamePath should return true for isSamePath("/foo%20bar", "/foo bar")
isSamePath should return false for isSamePath("/foo", "/bar")
isEqual should return true for isEqual("/foo", "foo", undefined)
isEqual should return true for isEqual("foo/", "foo", undefined)
isEqual should return true for isEqual("/foo bar", "/foo%20bar", undefined)
isEqual should return false for isEqual("/foo", "foo", {"leadingSlash":true})
isEqual should return false for isEqual("foo/", "foo", {"trailingSlash":true})
isEqual should return false for isEqual("/foo bar", "/foo%20bar", {"encoding":true})
withFragment should add or replace the fragment section of the URL
withoutFragment should remove the fragment section from the URL
withoutHost should remove the host from the URL
